name: Croome Play Areas
description: Two play areas a short walk from the RAF museum, visitor centre and café: an RAF-themed playground with a control tower, scramble net, bunker, slides and swings, and a Wild Play Area with a giant bird's nest, mud kitchens, a trim trail and den building, with shade and picnic benches.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the National Trust page for prices. National Trust members get in free.
